text:
maria-dev: Heads up — planning a vendor/submodule lockfile bump before tomorrow's cutoff. Can folks check their submodule pins?

aj: Noted. Which repos are we worried about?

maria-dev: primary ones: infra/vendor, runtime/third_party (go + python deps), and ops/ansible roles. We've seen mismatch between vendor/lock.json and submodule refs.

sam_k: I hit a CI failure in runtime image build: docker failed because vendor/lock.json had an older bcrypt wheel pinned. stack trace in CI.

leo: I can take infra/vendor. Quick checklist: run `./scripts/vendor-sync.sh` then `git add vendor/ && git commit -m \"vendor: bump lockfile\"` then push to your branch.

maria-dev: thanks. Also important: don't merge lockfile bumps into main after cutoff unless release lead approves. We'll do a single merge PR per component.

aj: Can we add a small script to validate submodule vs lockfile consistency? I can throw a quick check in CI to fail early.

maria-dev: yes please — something like: `git submodule foreach 'git rev-parse HEAD'` vs lockfile entries. If mismatch, fail with message and link to the sync guide.

sam_k: pinging @aj for a quick review on the runtime PR when it's up. I rebased and the test that flakes is the only blocker.

release-bot: Reminder: release cutoff at 2026-03-18 16:00 UTC. Only hotfixes and approved lockfile merges after that.

leo: FYI — infra/vendor had a tiny API change in the telemetry client; bumped to v1.4.3. I ran `go mod vendor` and updated lock.json. No runtime API breaks expected.

maria-dev: thanks leo. Please add a changelog blurb under Unreleased > infra: "vendor telemetry client -> v1.4.3" so the release notes capture it.

sam_k: runtime PR: 1773/runtime-vendor-bump. CI currently failing lint because a vendored file has trailing whitespace. I'll fix and re-run.

aj: I pushed a small CI job `check-lock-submodule` — it runs in ~20s. If everyone agrees I'll enable it on the release branches during the bump window.

maria-dev: enable it please. It'll save us merge churn.

leo: quick question: if vendor-sync.sh updates submodule refs, should we squash the commits? I lean towards a single vendor commit per repo to keep history clean.

aj: yeah single commit per repo is ideal. Also include the lockfile and a short commit message linking the PR.

sam_k: CI green after lint fix. PR is ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/420 (cc @aj @maria-dev)

maria-dev: looking now. If LGTM I'll merge before cutoff.

release-bot: NOTE: automatic changelog extraction runs on merge — ensure your PR description includes a one-line change summary.

leo: merged infra/vendor bump — changelog updated.

aj: added `check-lock-submodule` to release branch CI. It flagged infra/vendor earlier mismatch; good catch.

maria-dev: runtime PR merged by me at 1773112987 — release candidate now contains the vendor bumps. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :shipit:
